title: Cloud Control resource request by token
description: Gets the progress event for one Cloud Control resource request by its request token; poll it until the operation completes.

params.name: region
params.description: Region the request was made in

params.name: request_token
params.description: Request token returned by the originating mutation

outputs.name: Identifier
outputs.description: Identifier of the resource the request targets

outputs.name: OperationStatus
outputs.description: PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCESS, FAILED or CANCEL states

outputs.name: ErrorCode
outputs.description: Failure code when the operation failed, empty otherwise

outputs.name: EventTime
outputs.description: Timestamp of the latest progress event

template:
SELECT Identifier, Operation, OperationStatus, StatusMessage, ErrorCode, RetryAfter, ResourceModel, TypeName, EventTime
FROM awscc.cloud_control.resource_request
WHERE RequestToken = '{{request_token}}'
AND region = '{{region}}';
notes: Poll until OperationStatus is SUCCESS or FAILED; RetryAfter suggests how long to wait between polls. On failure, StatusMessage and ErrorCode carry the reason. On success, ResourceModel carries the resulting resource state, or re-read the resource directly. An unknown or expired token fails the request - completed requests age out of the service's history.
